metadata.value:

conda activate ppp
conda install python=3.9 pytorch-cuda torchvision torchaudio cudatoolkit -c pytorch -c nvidia --yes

cd PatchPerPix
PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH CUDA_ROOT=/usr/local/cuda pip install -e .
